propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall hierarchy
fetch_snapshot's three enrichment re-raise clauses match only BackendPaginationStallError, missing Cloud stalls and falling through to broad except Exception handlers that log and degrade silently
Cloud cursor pagination stalls produce silently degraded snapshots written without parent or link data instead of propagating the error and aborting the pass
fix changes RunawayPaginationError to subclass BackendPaginationStallError so the three fetcher re-raise clauses catch and propagate Cloud stalls correctly
existing except RuntimeError and except RunawayPaginationError sites remain unaffected because BackendPaginationStallError subclasses RuntimeError and preserves the Cloud-specific class name
